alisa: hey @matt @devon PTAL — I addressed the allocator race you flagged in PR #4321. Added a unit + stress test and squashed the fix into a single commit. Need one 👍 to reserve the canary slot for tomorrow 08:30 PST. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321
matt: skimmed it, nice cleanup. two tiny nits: 1) wording in the test comment, 2) import order. can you squash those into the commit? also can you confirm we didn't regress perf?
alisa: squashed and pushed the import/order/test comment fix. ran a quick local benchmark and a short stress job — added numbers to the PR description. cc: `/make ci-stress` runs on the new stress job.
devon: can you paste the bench output here? want the raw numbers for the release note diff.
alisa: ```
# local micro-bench (small harness)
baseline: throughput 1250 tokens/s
with-fix: throughput 1225 tokens/s
median latency: 6.2ms -> 6.3ms
p99 tail: 18.3ms -> 18.5ms
# stress job: 10m steady load, no OOMs, no extra retries
```
ops-bot: Canary slot available: 2026-03-19 08:30 PST on pool-a. To book: `/schedule-canary 2026-03-19T15:30Z pool-a`
matt: LGTM after the squash. @ryan can you merge when you take the slot? @alisa remove the debug log I pointed out and we're clear.
alisa: removed the debug log, left a tiny changelog line in the PR, and commented the schedule command to lock the slot. PTAL one last time if you want to skim; otherwise feel free to merge. :rocket:
ryan: grabbing the slot — I'll merge at ~15:25Z and watch the canary for 30m. :thumbsup:
